title: Dashboard UI redesign (operator spec 2026-11-09): overview, performance, strategies & models, work
roadmap_unmapped_reason: not set at filing -- manager to map to a milestone at the next weekly pass
note:
OPERATOR UI REDESIGN SPEC, 2026-11-09 ~10:10Z (chat to manager 2026-11-07a; paraphrased faithfully, operator's own words where quoted). Repo: benbaichmankass/ict-trader-dashboard (webapp/src).
OVERVIEW: (1) health bar across the top: trader VM, trainer VM, IB gateway, phone app, off-system training infra (Kaggle, Hugging Face) - all green at a glance. (2) remove the live money / paper portfolio / paper testing button bar; the Executive Summary book cards (open trades + live P&L per book) become the clickable selectors that drive the summary stats below (total equity, open trades, realized/unrealized P&L, win rate, profit factor). (3) open-trades rows clickable -> expand into a trade card with more detail (indicators, confidence scores, which models saw it) and the LIVE CHART of that market with the trade marked; several cards can be open at once, each with its own chart. The bottom live-chart carousel is removed. Open trades follow the exec-summary card selection. (4) work queue becomes three cards: waiting on me; in flight now (Claude lanes); testing queue (what runs now on ML/training infra); keep the link to the Work page. (5) remove Latest report. Keep News, maybe as a banner instead of a card. Remove the bottom live chart and the duplicate open-positions list. (6) Last closed trades: multi-select filter bar (live money / prop / paper portfolio / paper testing, any combination) + "show more" at the bottom. (7) default window 30 days (not 7); replace the window buttons with a days-back roller/slider.
PERFORMANCE: date-range picker (calendar, start+end) instead of window buttons; book selector at top (real money / prop / paper ...); list of performance reviews, openable; richer summary stats; breakdowns by strategy, asset class AND account; the full trade log lives here (richer than today, spec later). Remove Insights entirely; move Reports to an archive (old workflow); new performance reports appear in Performance.
STRATEGIES & MODELS: models first; apply the model naming regime; richer descriptions; for anything that has been in shadow or beyond, a hit-rate / good-call metric; hierarchical by model family -> versions (last retrain, current version, last update, performance vs past versions). Strategies page is not wired to real data - fix. Signals catalog (exists on the Claude console) hooked up here. GPU spend moves to Work. Remove Exit ladder as its own page. Backtesting: a log of every test run, its result and what we did with it. Remove Promotion ladder as a page; fold the promotion history into strategies/models. News layer stays, plus a summary: current model sentiment, its average over the past week and month, and what decisions/impact it had. Order packages log + signals move here.
ACCOUNTS: leave as is for now (operator has later ideas).
ACTIVITY: remove; positions dropped (overview has them); closed trades -> Performance trade log; order packages + signals -> Strategies & Models.
WORK: implement the JTA console's overview page as the design spec, as is; keep workflow + roadmap; Learning stays for now.
ADMIN: Data Explorer stays for now.
ALSO (same day): the LTR recommendations list with an approve button belongs in the redesigned console, wired through the same backend as the Telegram approve button (deferred to after the 11-11 reset, see LTR-GRADER-COVERAGE).
SCOPING RULE (operator): layout-only changes that are small can be done before the 2026-11-11 reset; new integrations / complex work wait for after the reset. ADDENDUM 2026-11-09 ~10:15Z (operator): the Overview 'waiting on me' card also lists the LTR decisions waiting on the operator (advice-only recommendations on open trades), each with Approve / Reject buttons that actually apply or dismiss it. Show them in RED (or similarly distinct) so a real-money trade decision is never confused with a housekeeping ask (e.g. take Claude off auto mode). Same backend as the deferred Telegram approve button (LTR-GRADER-COVERAGE note); post-reset, after the policy discussion on what a tap authorizes. ADDENDUM 2 2026-11-09 ~10:18Z (operator): CLOSED trades (Overview last-closed list, Performance trade log, anywhere they are listed) expand into cards with much more detail: the indicators/signals that got us in, how it closed (exit reason), the brackets and their history. Each closed-trade card shows a CHART SNAPSHOT framed with 15% extra time on each side of the open..close span and 10% extra price above the high and below the low; it draws the indicators, the entry, the exit and every bracket (SL/TP); each bracket change is marked on its line at the bar/time it happened; the entry signals/indicators are marked too. Purpose: trade review and finding improvements. Needs candles + bracket-change history + signal context per trade (journal notes live_review_actions / sl_floor / order_packages) -> a backend read endpoint; post-reset. DECISIONS 2026-11-09 ~10:20Z (operator): days-back = a SLIDER (not a button row) with snap points 1/7/30/90/180/365; news = one-line banner (current sentiment + one headline); health bar order = money-path first (trader VM, IB gateway, phone app), then trainer VM, Kaggle, Hugging Face; several live charts at once = yes, via ONE shared multi-symbol MarketStream (the old carousel already streamed several symbols). ADDENDUM 3 2026-11-09 ~10:22Z (operator): the closed-trade chart snapshot is NOT rendered live on each view. It is built ONCE when the trade closes and SAVED with the trade record (candles window + indicators + entry/exit + bracket history + entry signals, framed 15% time / 10% price), so the UI only reads the stored snapshot. Design: a close-time writer on the VM (off the order path, best-effort, retried; never blocks a close) + a backfill for already-closed trades; the stored form (rendered image vs the framed data the UI draws) to be decided when it is scoped post-reset. ADDENDUM 4 2026-11-09 ~10:25Z (operator): the Admin page gets the JTA console's WAKE SWITCHES page (view + flip, same backend as set_wake_toggle / GET+POST /api/bot/wake-toggles) and its SYSTEM page (system catalog / health as the console shows it). Admin/System clarification (operator ~10:27Z): the console System page has static parts (the system map / architecture diagram etc.) - those can be ported as-is first; live parts follow. ADDENDUM 5 2026-11-09 ~10:29Z (operator): every chart (closed-trade snapshot and open-trade live chart) also marks each LTR review / Claude decision on that trade at the bar where it was made: the recommendation (hold / tighten / partial_close / close ...), whether it was applied, advice-only or refused. Source: comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl + live-review/rows (review_id, reviewed_at, action, route/disposition) and directed_actions receipts. 2026-11-15 AM-OPS WORK-INFLIGHT-STALE-OWNERS sweep (manager 15a): in_flight -> queued, owner manager. owner AM-UI session_01AFoLuMr5RixbuwJtqED344 is ARCHIVED. No PR on the row.
